newsitem.title: INDIA: India's 1996/97 cotton crop seen at 15.5 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: India's 1996/97 cotton crop seen at 15.5 mln bales.

text.p: India's cotton crop in 1996/97 (October/September) is expected to be around 15.50 million 170-kg bales, marginally lower than the previous season's 16.15 million, textile ministry officials said on Tuesday.

They said the Cotton Advisory Board (CAB) in the federal ministry at its meeting on Monday estimated the 1996/97 crop at 18.15 million bales, including a carryover of 2.60 million from the previous season and imports of 0.05 million.
Total consumption in the current year was put at 16.65 million bales, including projected exports of 9.0 million, the officials said.
They estimated the 1996/97 surplus at 1.50 million bales, which will be carried over to the next season.
